headline: Clinton order changes the rules for an earlier presidential commission on celebrating women in American history.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 13090, which set up the President's Commission on the Celebration of Women in American History. The title does not say exactly what was changed. Such amendments often adjust a commission's deadlines, membership, or duties.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the President's Commission on the Celebration of Women in American History
who_it_affects.how: The rules guiding their work on the commission were changed in some way.
